metadata.title: SSPP – DNS Secure Transport (DoH / DoT)
metadata.remarks: System Security & Privacy Plan template defining institutional requirements for encrypted DNS transport using DNS over HTTPS (DoH) and/or DNS over TLS (DoT).

import-profile.remarks: Imports institutional baseline security, privacy, and governance requirements applicable to networked services.

system-characteristics.system-description: DNS transport service providing encrypted and integrity-protected DNS query transport using DNS over HTTPS (DoH) and/or DNS over TLS (DoT) for authorized DNS clients.

props.name: platform-capability
props.remarks: This SSPP governs encrypted DNS transport for DNS consumers using DoH or DoT.

props.name: usage-constraint
props.remarks: DoH/DoT usage MUST be explicitly approved. Encrypted DNS transport is not implied for all DNS consumers.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: Encrypted DNS transport does not alter DNS resolution semantics, validation behavior, or caching policy governed by Secure-DNS.

system-implementation.remarks: This SSPP defines policy, trust, and assurance requirements for DNS transport encryption. It does not redefine DNS resolution, caching, validation, or zoning behavior.

components.title: DNS Secure Transport Governance
components.description: Defines policy, approval, and trust expectations for encrypted DNS transport.

links.text: Relies on Secure-DNS for authoritative and resilient DNS behavior.
Relies on Secure-Networking for transport integrity and routing correctness.
Relies on Trusted-Cloud where DoH/DoT endpoints are provided as managed services.

components.title: DNS Secure Transport Authentication
components.description: Defines authentication and trust establishment between DNS clients and DoH/DoT endpoints.

components.title: DNS Secure Transport Privacy and Policy
components.description: Defines privacy guarantees, logging expectations, and policy constraints for encrypted DNS transport.

components.title: DNS Secure Transport Observability and Audit
components.description: Defines monitoring and audit requirements specific to encrypted DNS transport without degrading privacy guarantees.

roles.title: DNS Secure Transport Policy Authority
roles.remarks: Defines institutional policy for use of encrypted DNS transport, including approval criteria and acceptable use.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Executive Cyber Leadership per NIST NICE Framework (SP 800-181).

roles.title: DNS Secure Transport Architect
roles.remarks: Designs encrypted DNS transport architecture, trust relationships, and integration with Secure-DNS and network services.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Security Architect per NIST NICE Framework.

roles.title: DNS Secure Transport Operations
roles.remarks: Implements and operates approved DoH/DoT endpoints and client configurations.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Systems Administrator per NIST NICE Framework.

roles.title: DNS Secure Transport Monitoring and Assurance
roles.remarks: Monitors encrypted DNS transport endpoints, detects misuse or failure, and supports assurance reviews.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Security Operations Analyst per NIST NICE Framework.

control-implementation.remarks: Control satisfaction is achieved through enforced encryption, authenticated endpoints, transport policy, and controlled observability. This SSPP introduces no compensating controls.
